# Akim Kern

> Personal website of Akim Kern — founder of AkoDB, based in Tallinn, Estonia.

Akim Kern is a fan of databases/data and a student from Tallinn, Estonia. He founded AkoDB,
developed games on Roblox from 2021 to 2025 (520K+ total visits), was elected to
the Tallinn Youth Council in 2025 for a 2-year term, and founded and ran the Lasnamäe IT
Club in 2026. 

## Pages

- Home (#home): name, role (Founder of AkoDB), portrait.
- About (#about): chess, tech niches, Roblox development 2021-2025, Tallinn
  Youth City Council, Lasnamäe IT Club.
- Projects (#projects): filterable list (All / Programming / Other) with
  expandable rows.
- Contact (#contact): email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Lichess.
- Privacy (#privacy): privacy policy and hosting notes.
- llms.txt (#llms): this file, rendered on the page.

## Projects

- AkoDB (2026 - Present, Programming): "Innovation and safety first." Started as
  a practice project in the summer; grew as people took interest.
- Estonian Presidential Hackathon sponsored by OpenAI (2026, Programming):
  team reached the finals after product and idea review from the mentors.
- Meteorite Mining API (2026, Programming): Flask API that predicts mineral
  composition and mining risk from meteorite imagery using a convolutional
  neural network; API design and database integration.
- Lasnamäe IT Club (2026, Other): founded an IT club in Tallinn's largest
  district; taught tech topics, made quizzes and presentations.
- Tallinn Youth Council (2025 - 2027, Other): elected to represent Lasnamäe;
  learned how politics and bureaucracy work.
